mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_tickets (user_id, subject, description, priority, status, assigned_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{subject}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assignedTo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE assigned_to = #{assignedTo} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = #{priority} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM support_tickets ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM support_tickets ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = #{priority} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = #{priority}
